title: I'll Sing To You / Version - Zap-Pow

lines.l: Will you take a walk with me through the woods
And in the dark I'll display my goods
I'll sing to you my tune indefinite
I'll sing to you about birds and bees
While I'll tend to your needs
I'll sing to you my tune indefinite
I'll sing to you, about birds and bees, you'll get the tune, while I tend to your knees,
Oh, oh, oh, will you hold my hand, hold it fast and tight?
I'll understand, though it's internet, I'll sing to you, my tune indefinite.
To you, my team, indefinite, indefinite, indefinite
Will you take a walk with me through the woods, and in the dark I'll display my goods?
